summary: The release flow is coherent and idempotent across draft and already-published states, but the SPDX validator does not bind the document-level DESCRIBES relationship to the resume-builder root package.

findings.title: Require the SPDX document to describe the root package
findings.problem: The validator accepts any relationship whose type is DESCRIBES. A document that describes a dependency, or a relationship whose source is not SPDXRef-DOCUMENT, therefore passes even though the error and release contract require the document to describe the resume-builder source package.
findings.current_code: any(relationship.get("relationshipType") == "DESCRIBES" for relationship in relationships if isinstance(relationship, dict))
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve source_id before this check and require one relationship with spdxElementId == document["SPDXID"], relationshipType == "DESCRIBES", and relatedSpdxElement == source_id. Add a negative test that redirects DESCRIBES to a runtime dependency.
findings.resolution: Implemented the exact document-to-root predicate and added test_spdx_validator_rejects_document_describing_dependency.

positive_changes: The generation job verifies that the tag commit is in main history before producing release material.
Draft and already-published release states are distinguished, and reruns reject a published release that lacks the expected SBOM asset.
The write-capable job consumes only the validated cross-job artifact and verifies the downloaded release asset digest before publication.
